causes.label: Fuse is blown, or the circuit breaker tripped
remedies: Replace fuse or reset circuit breaker.
Remove any other appliances from the circuit.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Fuse is blown, or the circuit breaker tripped"

causes.label: Some of the sounds you’ll hear are normal
remedies: Hard food disposal shredding action.
Drain valve opening to pump water out.
Timer control as cycle progresses.
Detergent cup opening.
The motor stopping during the drying period.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Some of the sounds you’ll hear are normal"

causes.label: Utensils are not secure in the rack or something small has dropped into the rack
remedies: Make sure everything is secured in dishwasher.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Utensils are not secure in the rack or something small has dropped into the rack"

causes.label: Motor hums
remedies: Dishwasher has not been used on a regular basis.
If you do not use your dishwasher often, set it to fill and pump out once every week.
This will help keep the seal moist and the garbage disposer clear.

causes.label: Detergent with colorant was used
remedies: Some detergents contain colorant (pigment or dyes) that will discolor the tub interior with extended use.
Check the detergent cup for signs of any discoloration.
If cup is discolored, change to detergent without any colorant.
Cascade® Automatic Dishwashing Detergent has been approved for use in all GE dishwashers.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 21: "Detergent with colorant was used"

causes.label: Some tomato-based foods can stain
remedies: Use of the RINSE ONLY cycle (on some models) after adding the dish to the load can decrease the level of staining.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 21: "Some tomato-based foods can stain"

causes.label: Low inlet water temperature
remedies: Make sure inlet water temperature is correct.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 21: "Low inlet water temperature"

causes.label: Rinse agent dispenser is empty
remedies: Check the rinse agent dispenser.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 21: "Rinse agent dispenser is empty"

causes.label: Inlet water temperature is below 120°F
remedies: Raise the water heater temperature to 120°F.
Use HOT START option.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 21: "Inlet water temperature is below 120°F"

causes.label: Water pressure is temporarily low
remedies: Turn on a faucet.
Is water coming out more slowly than usual?
If so, wait until pressure is normal before using your dishwasher.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 21: "Water pressure is temporarily low"

causes.label: Air gap is clogged
remedies: Clean the air gap.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 21: "Air gap is clogged"

causes.label: Improper rack loading
remedies: Make sure large dishware does not block the detergent dispenser or the wash arm.

causes.label: Combination of soft water and too much detergent
remedies: This is called etching and is permanent.
To prevent this from happening, use less detergent if you have soft water.
Wash glassware in the shortest cycle that will get them clean.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 22: "Combination of soft water and too much detergent"

causes.label: Water temperature entering the dishwasher exceeds 150°F
remedies: Lower the water heater temperature.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 22: "Water temperature entering the dishwasher exceeds 150°F"

causes.label: Dial is not in the OFF position
remedies: Turn the Dial to OFF and slide the door latch to the left.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Dial is not in the OFF position"

causes.label: Dishes are blocking the detergent cups
remedies: Reposition the dishes.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Dishes are blocking the detergent cups"

causes.label: This is normal
remedies: Steam comes through the vent by the door latch during drying and when water is being pumped out.

symptoms.symptom: Black or gray marks on dishes

causes.label: Aluminum utensils have rubbed against dishes
remedies: Remove marks with a mild, abrasive cleaner.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 24: "Aluminum utensils have rubbed against dishes"
